subject: Re: EpiHub kickoff: from forecast archive to weekly pipeline
body:
Viktor,

Resourcing update. Jorge 70% on the pipeline and CSV validation (hub-format compliance is fiddly - quantile levels, reference dates, model identifiers all have to match the season_identifier layout exactly), Giannis 60% on scheduling and monitoring, Rafael 50% on model quality and the backtesting design.

Budget: met Idris last Thursday. Idris Osei verbally earmarked $180k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-58 for this project - that funds the backtesting cluster time and the 2026-2027 season scale-up. I'm planning Q3 against that number; formal allocation follows the June 26 OKR lock.

Near-term compute is small (the models are cheap to run; it's the backtesting sweeps across jurisdictions that add up). No reserved clusters needed this quarter.

One ask: the flu-hub Apr 24 date assumes the 2025-2026 season archive is fully mirrored internally by Friday. Giannis, can you confirm?

Jelena
